app.name: Campaign Table
app.tagline: Run your D&D 2024 campaign on your own host.

connection.label: Connection
connection.disconnected: Disconnected. Actions are paused until the connection returns.

save.failed: Language preference could not be saved. It still applies on this device.

auth.signInIntro: Use the account your Dungeon Master created or the one you made with an invite.
auth.registerIntro: Enter the invite code from your Dungeon Master to join their campaign.
auth.bootstrapIntro: No accounts exist yet. Create the first account; it will run campaigns as Dungeon Master.
auth.usernameHint: 3–32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
auth.pitchTitle: Your table. Your rules. Your server.
auth.pitch1: Runs on the Dungeon Master’s computer. Players only open a link.
auth.pitch2: Players join with a one-time invite code.
auth.pitch3: Everyone picks English or Bahasa Indonesia for themselves.

lobby.title: Your campaigns
lobby.empty: You are not in any campaign yet. Create one or join with an invite.
lobby.subtitle: Pick up where your party left off, or gather a new one.

room.removeBody: They lose access right away. You can invite them again later.
room.invitesIntro: Each code lets one player join. Codes are shown once, when created.
room.newInviteHelp: Copy it now and send it to your player. It will not be shown again.
room.noAccess: You do not have access to this campaign.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not match any page.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the information is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That username and password do not match.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.ORIGIN_REJECTED: This request came from an unexpected page and was blocked.
errors.BOOTSTRAP_CLOSED: This host is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: That invite code is not valid or was already used.
errors.CANNOT_REMOVE_DM: The Dungeon Master cannot be removed.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: That member is no longer in the campaign.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {{retryAfterSeconds}} seconds.
errors.UNKNOWN_COMMAND: The host does not recognise that action.
errors.REQUEST_ID_REUSED: That action conflicts with an earlier one. Refresh and try again.
errors.STALE_REVISION: Someone changed this first. Review the latest version and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That item could not be found.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: That file type is not supported.
errors.OFFLINE: You are offline. Nothing was sent; try again once reconnected.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on the host. Try again.

reference.title: Rules reference
reference.searchHint: English and Indonesian terms both work.
reference.noResults: No results. Try another word, or the English term.
reference.noBookmarks: Nothing saved yet. Use Bookmark on any entry.
reference.sourceGuide: Written for this app to help beginners; not SRD text.
reference.sourceCampaign: Campaign content, shown only to members allowed to see it.
reference.translatedNote: Unofficial app translation; the English source is kept.
reference.intro: New to D&D? Start here, or search for any word you heard at the table. Reading a rule never spends anything.
